item: Wet toekomst pensioenen (Wtp) entry into force
detail: Statutory effective date of the Wtp itself.

item: Original statutory transition-period end date (as enacted 2023)
detail: The Wtp as originally passed required all pension funds/insurers to have completed the DB-to-DC conversion by this date.

item: Extension bill (wetsvoorstel 36.578, 'Wet verlenging transitieperiode') passed by Eerste Kamer
detail: The Dutch Senate approved a ONE-YEAR extension of the transition deadline. Minister Marielle Paul's stated reason: to allow a 'careful and controlled transition' for pension funds, insurers and social partners.
CONFIRMS the brief's second-hand claim as CORRECT for the CURRENT deadline - but see the next row: this is a MOVED deadline, not the original one.

IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the extension law also relocated the deadline itself out of the primary Wtp statute and into an AMvB (Algemene Maatregel van Bestuur - a government administrative order that does not require full parliamentary passage to amend). Per the Eerste Kamer's own text, this was done explicitly to allow 'faster government adjustment if further extensions prove necessary.' Effective date of this change: 'op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip' (a date to be fixed by royal decree, i.e. not yet a fixed calendar date at time of passage).

item: DNB-reported transition progress consistent with the above
detail: 30 funds transitioned by 1 Jan 2026 (~1/3 of assets); 34 funds by 30 Jun 2026 (34.2% of assets, EUR 589bn of EUR 1,720bn) - i.e. the transition is running but is well short of complete a little over halfway to the (extended) deadline.
